dedupe_keys.name: списък на общинските пътища на територията на област сливен

description: Списък на общинските пътища на територията на област Сливен is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Data Department - State e-Government Agency. List of municipal roads on the territory of the region of Sliven, Decision No 567/04.08.2017 of the Council of Ministers, at each update – in accordance with Article 9(3)(4) of the NSUPIIOSNOPF. Coverage: BG. The portal shows the English title as "List of municipal roads in the region of Sliven" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Сливен, РМС 567/2021, общински пътища, област, списък, общински. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
